## What does this change?

Describe the improvement and the user-visible effect.

## Safety & research integrity checklist

- [ ] Does not run model APIs or network installs without explicit permission.
- [ ] Does not introduce secrets, real private datasets, or confidential logs.
- [ ] Preserves scientific provenance and distinguishes snapshots from validation.
- [ ] Adds tests or documentation for behavior changes.
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes locally.

## Manual test notes

Include test steps and results. If testing was not possible, explain why.
